trigger: P0582 found that 20*tanh(x/20) was the only smooth saturation curve to preserve all exact roots across the four P0581 clusters.
question: Does the fully locked K0338 endpoint rule with tanh-20 saturation transfer to exact RX J2129 raw image roots without choosing any gravity parameter on RX J2129?

independence.formula_selection: RX J2129 was not in the ten-cluster inverse driver that set the K0338 extent relation, the two P0579 raw clusters, or the four P0581-P0582 exact-root clusters.
independence.project_history: RX J2129 raw images have been used extensively by other formula families, so this is new to K0338/tanh-20 but not globally fresh data.

locked_formula.residence: endpoint only toward the member-light centroid
locked_formula.carrier: P0554 scalar excess over local baryonic gravity

fit.within_family_split: Use the already frozen RX J2129 training/held-out image split.

claim_limits: RX J2129 is independent of K0338/tanh-20 selection but is spent at the broader project level.
The hard photometric member catalog omits hot gas and diffuse intracluster light.
Six conventional lens-geometry nuisances and training-family source positions are refitted per variant.
The zero-monopole endpoint channel tests angular placement, not absolute cluster lensing strength.
A one-cluster transfer cannot establish universality.
